classes.name: ActionInstanceAdmissionModule
classes.description: Sekai-owned deep module whose interface admits one governed ActionInstance and owns validation, idempotent replay, policy and budget decisions, receipt and audit ordering, effect planning, and post-admission metering.

classes.name: SekaiGrpcTransportAdapter
classes.description: gRPC adapter that authenticates callers, enforces tenant, namespace, marking, purpose, and capability preflight, and maps protocol messages and errors around Sekai domain modules.

classes.name: GovernedActionInstance
classes.description: Durable admission envelope for a versioned governed action type, exact parameters, evidence references, principal, policy and budget outcomes, and operation receipt identity.

relations.name: delegates_action_instance_admission_to
relations.description: The gRPC transport adapter delegates ActionInstance lifecycle admission to the transport-neutral admission module after authentication and tenant enforcement.

relations.name: admits_governed_action_instance
relations.description: The admission module validates and durably records a governed ActionInstance together with its receipt, audit evidence, and planned effects.
